text:
alex_eng: Heads up — after running npm ci on our API service, calls to client.chat.create started returning 404s. No code change besides fresh install. Anyone seen this?

sam_support: Hey @alex_eng, sorry for the disruption. Can you share the package.json line for the SDK, minimal repro, and the exact HTTP response body you see?

alex_eng: package.json shows "@redwood/sdk": "^0.18.2". Minimal repro below (Node 18):

```
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })

const res = await client.chat.create({
  model: 'redwood-alpha',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Summarize the PRs' }]
})
console.log(res)
```

Axios error:

```
Error: Request failed with status code 404
response.data: { error: 'route_not_found', message: 'No route for /v1/chat.create' }
```

sam_support: Thanks. Two quick diagnostics: 1) are you behind any proxy or API gateway that might rewrite paths? 2) can you try upgrading the SDK locally to see if it fixes it?

alex_eng: No proxy. Outbound request target is https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.create as per our logs. Upgrading in prod is nontrivial; can we confirm root cause first?

nate_engineer: Jumping in Looks like this is a version/contract mismatch. We changed the official endpoint naming in the public API in the last minor release: /v1/chat.create was replaced by /v1/chat.complete, and param keys changed (model -> model_name, messages -> input). SDK v0.19+ maps to the new surface; SDK v0.18.x still emits the old route -> 404.

sam_support: Short-term options:
- Upgrade the SDK to >=0.19.0 (recommended)
- Use a direct HTTP POST to the new endpoint as a temporary workaround

nate_engineer: Example fallback request you can paste into your code until you upgrade:

```
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.complete', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model_name: 'redwood-alpha', input: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Summarize the PRs' }] })
})
```

Note the param rename: older SDK used `model` + `messages`. New API expects `model_name` + `input`. SDK >=0.19.0 includes the translator.

alex_eng: OK that makes sense. Our CI uses semver ^0.18.2 so it pulled the older 0.18.x pin after npm ci. We'll test upgrading to 0.20.0 in a branch first. Any recommended flags for npm to avoid surprises?

sam_support: If you want exact pinning, set "@redwood/sdk": "0.20.0" and run `npm ci`. Otherwise ^0.20.0 is fine. We also posted migration notes in the changelog: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/changelog#v0.19.0 which lists param mappings and breaking notes.

alex_eng: I tried 0.20.0 in a feature branch and ran unit tests. Client now issues /v1/chat.complete and the 404s are gone locally. Planning rollout to staging.

nate_engineer: For customers pinned to older deps, we'll ship a one-release compatibility shim in 0.20.x to help gradual rollouts. We'll announce the compatibility window in #announcements.

sam_support: Thanks for confirming. I'll mark this thread resolved but ping us if any downstream issues after the rollout. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployed feature/upgrade-sdk to staging  2026-03-05T09:14:22Z

alex_eng: Staging looks good, will roll to prod after the next maintenance window. Appreciate the quick help! :rocket:
